summary: IPALCO Enterprises filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary AES Indiana received a rate order from the Indiana Utility Regulation Commission approving base rates for 2027 electric service. The order sets a revenue requirement of $1,979.7 million, a return on common equity of 9.5%, and a rate base of $5.5 billion. Rates will be implemented in two phases starting July 2026 and January 2027. This is a routine regulatory filing regarding utility rate proceedings with no special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist involvement, or structural change affecting securities.
